conceptual assets.information: The CSR write/read strobes and address determine whether the transmit FIFO is written and which status or received-data value is selected or acknowledged. The command only enters through the CSR control ports; it does not leave as a carried value because it only decides internal actions and acknowledgements.
conceptual assets.rubric reason: Integrity: changing csr_we_i, csr_re_i or csr_addr_i can redirect writes, reads or acknowledgements through the logic at lines 46-60. Availability: these ports gate transmit FIFO writes and the CSR/ICC acknowledgement path at lines 59-60, so an attacker can prevent required transfers or responses.
conceptual assets.attack: An attacker can alter the CSR strobes or address to inject unintended transmit operations, suppress FIFO writes, or prevent the expected read acknowledgement and communication progress.

conceptual assets.information: The transmit FIFO's occupancy and availability state determines whether queued inter-core words can be accepted and whether a word is available for transmission. It is generated and held inside tx_queue_inst rather than entering through a unit port, and is exposed through the CSR status and ICC readiness outputs.
conceptual assets.rubric reason: Integrity: enqueue and dequeue activity changes the FIFO state through the write and read controls at lines 82 and 85, so unauthorized activity can corrupt the reported queue availability. Availability: the FIFO produces free and available indications at lines 83 and 87 that determine whether transmit data can be accepted or supplied to the peer.
conceptual assets.attack: An attacker can flood the FIFO or manipulate dequeue activity so that its availability state is falsified or remains unavailable, causing transmit data to be lost or communication to stall.

considered, not kept.reason: Forwarded-transactions and relayed-data rules exclude the payload because this unit does not store or compute it; it only moves from csr_wdata_i through the FIFO instance to icc_tx_o.dat at lines 81 and 86.
The transfer-record rule excludes the received word as a separate piece because icc_rx_i.dat is conditionally copied to csr_rdata_o under icc_rx_i.rdy at lines 51-52 without being stored or computed.

The transfer-record rule treats the ICC acknowledge, ready and data-movement handshake as part of the transfer rather than an independent conceptual asset; the relevant fields are wired or assigned at lines 59, 85 and 87.
The clocks-and-resets rule excludes clk_i and rstn_i because they are only wired to the FIFO instance at lines 75-76 and do not constitute information of their own.
